summary: Held my one position -- GOOGL 7 sh @ 327.67 avg, 22.9% of a $9,999 bankroll -- and placed no new orders. This was the pre-registered pre-close check on whether the 321-325 reclaim held, and it did decisively: session low 324.45, closing ~327.5 in the upper half of the 324.45-330.41 range, with the four-hour afternoon drift dying on collapsing volume (107k to 14k per bar) before buyers lifted it back into the bell on rising volume. The mechanism I bought is spreading rather than fading (Barron's: Alphabet changed Wall Street's favorite AI metric, Microsoft and Meta are up next), NVDA remains -4.5%, and oil -8% plus Trump jawboning for rate cuts relieve the macro de-rating I identified Friday. I did not add (an 8th share would breach the 25% cap) and did not open a second position on 25 minutes of research into FOMC week -- activity bias named. Invalidation unchanged at a decisive break of 321; target 342.
